policies.name: Commercial General Liability Occurrence
policies.description: Comprehensive liability coverage for general contractors.
policies.fullDescription: Commercial General Liability Occurrence policy providing coverage for bodily injury and property damage arising from business operations, including products/completed operations, personal and advertising injury, and damage to premises rented to you.
keyFeatures: Coverage for Damage to Premises Rented to You
Blanket wording for Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Scheduled Person or Organization
Blanket wording for Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Completed Operations

covered: A third-party bodily injury claim resulting from a slip and fall at a construction site.
Property damage to a client's home caused by a contractor's ongoing operations.
A lawsuit alleging libel or slander in the course of business operations.
Fire damage to a rented office space caused by the insured's negligence.
Medical expenses for a visitor injured on the insured's premises.
notCovered: Claims arising from professional errors or omissions (Exclusion - Professional Services).
Losses due to cyber incidents or data breaches (Exclusion - Cyber Injury).
Claims related to asbestos or lead exposure (Exclusion - Asbestos, Exclusion - Lead).
Injuries to temporary, casual, or volunteer workers (Exclusion - Injury To Temporary, Casual Or Volunteer Workers).
Damage caused by unmanned aircraft (Exclusion - Unmanned Aircraft).
Losses from certified acts of terrorism (unless specifically purchased).
Claims arising from operations in New York State (Exclusion - Operations - State Of New York).
Damage to property from wildfire (Exclusion - Wildfire).
Losses due to snow removal or ice removal operations (Exclusion - Snow Removal and Ice Removal).

considerations: Policy is non-admitted, meaning it is not covered by state guaranty funds.
Quote is valid for 30 days from March 3, 2026.
Premium is 100% minimum and 100% deposit, subject to 25% minimum earned premium upon binding.
Terrorism coverage is optional and requires separate acceptance/rejection, with an additional premium if accepted.
Specific requirements for subcontractor agreements, including CGL policy, A.M. Best rating of A- VI or better, additional insured status, and primary/non-contributory coverage.
A $20,000 deductible penalty applies for contractors conditions related to uninsured or underinsured subcontractors.

Various exclusions apply, including but not limited to War, Unmanned Aircraft, Employment-Related Practices, Pollution, Silica, Cyber Injury, Demolition, Roofing, PFAS, Biometric Information, New Residential Construction, Breach of Contract, Prior Work, Operations in New York, Snow Removal, Wildfire, Punitive Damages, Asbestos, and Lead.
coverageStrengths: Comprehensive General Liability coverage for general contractors.
High limits for general aggregate and each occurrence.
Damage to Premises Rented to You coverage included.
Broad form deductible for combined bodily injury and property damage.
